articles.title: Crypto hacker convicted of $53M theft after spending millions on rare Pokemon and Magic cards
articles.snippet: A Crypto hacker has been convincted of stealing $50 million before spending some of it on rare Pokemon and Magic: The Gathering cards.

articles.title: Logan Paul ends 63-hour Pokemon hunt after finally finding Shiny Onix

articles.snippet: Kanye West went on a shopping spree with his kids and spent thousands of dollars on Pokemon cards for them.

articles.snippet: The Pokemon Trading Card Game is reportedly releasing its first Valentine’s Day set, complete with a special box that can be transformed into a mailbox.

articles.snippet: A Pokemon promo card that never reached stores sold for $8.4 million after 64 bids at Fanatics Collect.

articles.title: FBI says ShinyHunters leader arrested as Pokemon-themed hacking group faces probe

articles.title: McDonald’s x Pokemon reportedly returning in November for 30th anniversary

articles.title: Pokemon collector who GPS-tracked a card delivery driver sentenced to wear a tracker himself
